Technical Writer

Wonka Labs makes developer tools for confectionery automation. We are hiring a Technical Writer to own our public documentation, from the first tutorial to the API reference, and to make it a reason people choose us.

Responsibilities

Write and maintain guides, references and release notes. Interview engineers and turn what they know into pages a newcomer can follow. Measure which pages fail readers and fix them. HIDDEN-UNTIL-EXPANDED marker.

Requirements

Four years of technical writing for developers, the ability to read code in at least one language, and experience with docs-as-code workflows.
